name: Wake Forest University
character: The Reynolda Campus is known for its Georgian architecture centered around two interlinked quads, with nearby formal gardens, woods, and a lake.

landmarks.name: Reynolda Hall
landmarks.quote: separated by the main administrative building and dining facility, Reynolda Hall, into North and South Campus.
landmarks.look: Georgian-style administrative and dining hall separating two quads.

landmarks.name: Hearn Plaza
landmarks.quote: North Campus consists of Hearn Plaza, better known as "the quad"
landmarks.look: Open campus quad surrounded by Georgian residential buildings and Wait Chapel.

landmarks.name: Manchester Quad
landmarks.quote: South Campus is the home of Manchester Quad, named for substantial donors Doug and Elizabeth Manchester.
landmarks.look: Open campus quad surrounded by classroom buildings, housing, and a library.

landmarks.name: Z. Smith Reynolds Library
landmarks.quote: It holds freshman housing, most of the classroom buildings, the Benson Center, and the Z. Smith Reynolds Library.
landmarks.look: Plain Georgian-style university library building on the South Campus quad.

landmarks.name: Wait Chapel
landmarks.quote: which holds six upperclassmen residential buildings, Subway restaurant, a book/office supply store, a clothing/athletic store, and Wait Chapel.
landmarks.look: Georgian-style campus chapel with classrooms located on Hearn Plaza.

landmarks.name: Reynolda House Museum of American Art
landmarks.name_en: Reynolda House Museum of American Art
landmarks.quote: Reynolda House Museum of American Art is the centerpiece of the Reynolda Estate, from which the university's Reynolda Campus takes its name.
landmarks.look: Historic 1917 residence converted into an art museum.

landmarks.name: Reynolda Gardens
landmarks.quote: The 129-acre (52-hectare) property that constitutes Reynolda Gardens of Wake Forest University... included a lake, golf course, formal gardens, greenhouses, and woods.
landmarks.look: Expansive preserve with formal gardens, greenhouses, woods, and a lake.

landmarks.name: Benson Center
landmarks.quote: It holds freshman housing, most of the classroom buildings, the Benson Center, and the Z. Smith Reynolds Library.
landmarks.look: Plain Georgian-style campus building located on Manchester Quad.
